title: Aura canonical finding record
description: One line of 00-evidence/findings.jsonl. Reconstructed by Stage 0 and PROPOSED until the founder ratifies it — there is no pre-existing canonical F-register artifact.

claim.description: What the finding actually asserts is wrong or owed.

system.description: System the finding concerns, as recorded at the time — NOT the root-system classification, which Agent A derives separately.

state.description: Copied verbatim from evidence. No agent may promote this value. Infrastructure existing is not an obligation satisfied.

originChapter.description: Chapter or investigation that raised it.

evidenceStrength.description: WEAK where the id appears only once or twice across the corpus. INSUFFICIENT items must be surfaced for founder adjudication, never guessed.

source.description: Repo-relative doc path, or transcript filename.

anchor.description: Heading, line number, or quoted fragment.
